name: Millennium class
notes: Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excl. bars and suite/AquaClass venues (Sushi on Five, Le Petit Chef, Tuscan Grille). Jogging track: Celebrity says every ship has one; Cruise Spotlight says no (official source used).

name: Solstice class
notes: Specialty: Sushi on Five, Fine Cut Steakhouse, Murano, Trattoria Rossa. Pickleball set per ship (2023 rollout named Solstice, Equinox, Eclipse only).

name: Edge class
notes: Specialty: Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro, Eden Restaurant, Fine Cut Steakhouse, Le Petit Chef & Family, Rooftop Garden Grill, Magic Carpet, Dinner on the Edge. No basketball court; pickleball in Rooftop Garden (set per ship). Pools: 1 general, 1 adults-only Solarium, 1 Retreat.

name: Vision class
notes: Representative ships: Vision of the Seas. Specialty: Izumi, Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's Table. Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excluding bars, coffee and ice-cream shops. Pools per representative ship.

name: Voyager class
notes: Representative ship: Voyager of the Seas. Specialty: Izumi Sushi & Hot Rocks, Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's Table. Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excluding bars, coffee and ice-cream shops. Pools per representative ship.

name: Radiance class
notes: Representative ships: Serenade, Brilliance. Specialty: Izumi Sushi & Hot Rocks, Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's Table. Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excluding bars, coffee and ice-cream shops. Pools per representative ship.

name: Freedom class
notes: Representative ship: Liberty of the Seas. Specialty: Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's Table, Izumi Teppanyaki, Johnny Rockets. Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excluding bars, coffee and ice-cream shops. Pools per representative ship.

name: Oasis class
notes: Representative ship: Allure of the Seas. Specialty: Izumi, 150 Central Park, Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's Table, Johnny Rockets, Samba Grill. Specialty = extra-charge restaurants open to all guests, excluding bars, coffee and ice-cream shops. Pools per representative ship.

name: Quantum class
notes: Representative ship: Ovation of the Seas. Specialty: Chef's Table, Chops Grille, Giovanni's, Izumi, Izumi Teppanyaki. Pickleball indoors in SeaPlex. No jogging track on Ovation.
